asset: Hokkaido traditional bear biting salmon v24b independent Blender real GLB candidate
reviewer: ChatGPT direct visual inspection of actual v23b / v24 / v24b Blender Cycles renders and trimesh check of exported v24b GLB

bear_anatomy_and_silhouette.reason: Larger shoulder and tapered head read a little more naturally than v23b, but torso-to-limbs still resembles joined geometric blocks.

face_and_expression.reason: The previously glued lower-jaw spheres are gone, and muzzle is more continuous. Eyes/ears remain button-like; jaw still does not visibly clamp fish.

salmon_shape_and_bite.reason: Fish was uniformly shortened along its length and deepened outside the central bite section. It is less plank-like but the head now resembles a blunt oval, external fish eyes appear as dots, and jaw contact remains unclear.

carving_detail_and_wood.reason: V24b deliberately concentrates on basic volume with matte wood colors only. True directional chisel geometry is not yet authored, so finished carving cannot pass.

paws_and_limbs.reason: Foot tips and lower ankles have more irregular contours than the original cylinders, but lack convincing wrist, knuckle and individual toe articulation.

multi_view_presentation.reason: Real full GLB and four unmodified Blender Cycles render views, with file hashes and independently reproduced geometry checks.

geometry_evidence.method: independent Blender 5.2.2 LTS + Blender Cycles four views; actual GLB inspected with trimesh, not image-generated; not official 3DCodeVerse Harness generation

defects.finding: Even after remodeling jaw continuously, front and 45-degree renders show the salmon lying beneath the nose, not convincingly trapped by upper and lower jaw structures.
defects.required_fix: Stop adjusting primitive loft controls locally. Construct the head and clamping jaw from reference-matched sculpted surface geometry; inspect orthographic side and front at high resolution before adding a fish.

defects.finding: Shortening improves fish length-to-depth, but the head is now a rounded blunt volume, and the tiny eyes look like floating black dots.
defects.required_fix: Separate salmon head sculpt with anatomical mouth/gill/eye cavities built directly into its watertight body; no external eye beads.

defects.finding: Paws are slightly reshaped yet continue to resemble heavy cylindrical boots.
defects.required_fix: Use real bear anatomical reference silhouette, build shoulder/forearm/wrist/paw transitions and individual toe planes in a sculpt rather than multi-ring cylinders.

defects.finding: The present matte brown surfaces remain bare and do not have directional hand-chiseled fur marks.
defects.required_fix: After shape approval, carve directionally with longer tapering negative gouges concentrated around shoulders and belly, not random pitting.

improvement_tasks: v24b is a genuine generated GLB and technical success, not an artistically approved model.
Body and fish body are watertight but sculpt quality remains below gate: keep candidates separate and never overwrite formal model.
The 2D side/face reference proportions must become primary explicit constraints, especially salmon head, fish eye, jaw contact and limb contours.
Stop iterative parameter changes to axis-aligned ellipsoid/loft primitives as sole primary modeling technique; pursue physically sculpted high-poly mesh or reputable license-verifiable base mesh.
Only after reference-locked geometry is accepted should chisel relief, UV, high-to-low baking and final PBR texturing begin.
